source.kind: Direct latest Human message in Coordinator conversation; normalized preserving scope
source.text: 這是 Human Owner 的直接授權：現在啟動完整契約的連續實作流程，由你統一協調、派工、收件與推進。Checkpoint 已透過 PR #7 合併，固定恢復點 9003c00b214ac29cafcb6cc22ac10693ac92a0bf。目標是完整實作、跑通並驗證 checkpoint 所包含的 IH-005 與已接受修訂，包含先前各 Slice 尚未交付的契約範圍；提案、筆記、已撤回或明確延後的能力不得自動加入。繼續 work 分支，授權正常提交並推送 https://github.com/yeataro/Grape.git 的 work。Coordinator 自行派實作者與獨立 Fresh Reviewer，維持單一寫入責任者及隔離；先處理目前 S06 尚未獨立審查成果，再依相依性推進。取代逐 Slice 授權、驗收、PR、merge 及逐批人類預覽停點；技術 PASS 後直接下一已授權批次。普通缺陷/測試/證據/派工問題由 Coordinator 修復複查收件。保留 checkpoint/歷史/未解限制，禁止強推、丟棄、frozen handoff 改動、把技術 PASS 記成人類驗收。只有真正產品/架構決策、Human 權限或實機才找 Human，只停受影響部分。全部完成獨立審查後提供可操作測試環境、可見版號、localhost 與簡短完整清單作整體驗收。未授權最終 merge main 或正式發布。核對登記後直接開始，不必再問啟動或 PM 轉交。

acceptedAmendments.scope: Object information uses F2 as the sole opening interaction. Preserve current live-keyboard-focus identity policy, readonly owner projections, detail content, Close/Escape and safe focus return. Remove the separate Read object details opening button and alternate diagnostic-hover presentation/checkbox. Ordinary hover operation hints and accessible names remain. No replacement gesture or extra entry invented. F2 must work directly without first enabling the removed diagnostic-hover preference. Existing readonly availability, unfinished text/draft/IME/gesture and lifetime guards remain; this is not permission to steal editing keys or revive invalid targets. Keep bottom status, Shader Output, Locate, existing grouped actions, type-color solid socket states and clean reusable floating ownership unchanged. Help and 本輪更新 must accurately describe F2-only behavior. Candidate I e8c477ec511637f71646b79272422c72e40bd680 pending independent review; requirement acceptance only.
acceptedAmendments.acceptedBy: Human Owner (requirements only; no implementation acceptance)

acceptedAmendments.scope: Object inspection is an optional outer presentation/development helper using existing owner-provided public readonly projections. No new Graph/model ownership, core reflection API, synchronized mirror store or serialization authority. Obtain detail on explicit F2 action; do not add whole-model capture/serialization on normal pointer movement or make core editing depend on inspection registration. Preserve ordinary hints. Inspection cannot change selection, Graph values/revision/dirty/History/Redo, document storage/ACK or shader generation. Focus/text/draft/IME/gesture guards remain; closing returns safe focus. Failure, unavailable targets, projection errors, same-ID replacement, unmount/dispose or late callbacks remain isolated to the helper. No stale authority, leaked listener/timer, core command suppression or core crash. Use the accepted public view/mount optional presentation seam, caller-owned data and common surface lifecycle. Disabled/absent/disposed inspector must leave normal application flow functional. Do not create new private traversal or feature-specific core branches. Candidate I e8c477ec511637f71646b79272422c72e40bd680 pending independent review; requirement acceptance only.
